correctness.rationale: The proof reduces idempotent averaging to image subalgebra and stable kernel, constructs the unit and primitive indicator blocks of every finite-field subalgebra, obtains unique sum-one functional weights on each block, and counts labeled ranks. Under the exact algebra automorphism group S_n, conjugacy reduces to multisets of normalized weights. Additive-character Fourier inversion yields the integral modular exponent mu_s and therefore the complete Euler product. Matrix identity, rank, and permutation-conjugacy checks are independently replayed in prime fields and F_4/F_9; infinite claims rest on algebraic proofs, not enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural exact invariant is the full algebra-automorphism conjugacy-rank distribution of all idempotent averaging operators on the fundamental split finite étale algebra in every dimension. The result gives the explicit Euler product with characteristic-sensitive exponents, not just a known universal structural reduction, and an independent labeled rank polynomial. It identifies the precise p-divisible obstruction in the otherwise uniform multiset orbit count, including nonprime fields, and provides reproducible full operator counts rather than arbitrary small examples.
